verdict.rationale: Feitian documents iePassManager on Android for 'credential related operations' and SK Manager for managing FIDO functions, which suggests passkey management tooling exists. Listing and deleting individual passkeys is never stated explicitly. On capacity, the only relevant claim is that the MultiPass key has no limit on registered accounts, which does not tell the user how many discoverable credential (passkey) slots the key has. Missing for 10: explicit list/delete of resident passkeys, a desktop credential-management workflow, documented passkey slot capacity or remaining-space indicator, hands-on corroboration.
